context_visible: Aerial view of a rural settlement adjacent to a river system with green water.
A cluster of single-story residential buildings with red and blue roofs situated on a peninsula-like landform.
Rectangular plots of green crops located between the buildings and the water.
A narrow paved road runs parallel to the riverbank.
Vegetation includes bare deciduous trees and dry reeds along the water's edge.
cross_view_relations: The local crop image is a zoomed-in view of the central cluster of buildings and gardens seen in the wide context image.
The red-roofed structures and the specific layout of the garden plots are consistent across both views.
The wide view confirms the settlement's isolation by water on multiple sides.
perception.description: Aerial imagery shows a rural settlement on a river peninsula. The scene features single-story houses with red and blue roofs, surrounded by rectangular vegetable gardens and a paved road. The area is bordered by green water and dry vegetation, with a zoomed view highlighting the building details and garden plots.
evidence_visible: Close-up view of the residential cluster showing a main house with a red roof and an adjacent smaller structure with a red roof.
A dilapidated brick structure with an open roof stands near the garden plots.
A white building with a blue roof is visible to the left.
Garden plots contain rows of green leafy crops.
A small concrete utility building is located near the center of the cluster.
